data.long_meaning: Balamani is a combination of two Sanskrit words: 'Bal' meaning strength and 'Mani' meaning jewel or goddess. This name signifies a powerful and divine woman. The name is a reminder of the spiritual strength we carry within ourselves and the divine blessings we call upon to navigate our lives.
